app.title: Sahba — Carousel studio
app.name: Sahba
nav.label: Main navigation
claude.disabledHint: Claude isn't connected. Open Settings → Claude & device to fix it.
claude.gate.body: Actions that need Claude are disabled until it's connected. Everything else still works.
claude.title: Claude connection
claude.sub: Sahba uses your own Claude Code subscription on this computer. No API keys.
claude.explain.ok: Everything is ready. Claude can write, polish and revise for you.
claude.explain.missing: Install Claude Code, then press “Check again”. The device checks below show the exact step.
claude.explain.loggedOut: Open a terminal, run claude and sign in once. Then press “Check again”.
claude.explain.offline: The Sahba server isn't responding. Make sure the start window is still open.
lang.waitRun: Wait for the current run to finish before switching language.
lang.sub: The interface language. Your carousel content stays in the language you write in.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.busy: Another task is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the Sahba server. Is the start window still open?
phase.retry.msg: Found issues — Claude is fixing them…
welcome.sub.lang: Turn your ideas into professional carousels, written in your voice. First, choose the interface language.
welcome.sub.about: Short honest answers are enough. Claude uses them to learn your audience and your voice.
welcome.sub.identity: Your name, handle and photo appear on your slides. You can change them any time.
welcome.sub.template: This is the default look for your carousels. You can switch per carousel later.
welcome.langHint: You can change this later in Settings.
welcome.q.goal: What do you want followers to do?
welcome.q.dislikes: What do you hate in content?
welcome.h.work: Your field, your role, what you're good at.
welcome.h.audience: Who they are, their level, what they struggle with.
welcome.h.goal: Follow, save, DM you, buy a service…
welcome.h.dialect: e.g. Levantine, Gulf, Egyptian, formal Arabic — casual or serious.
welcome.h.samples: Paste 2–3 captions or posts you wrote and liked.
welcome.h.dislikes: Clichés, emojis, clickbait… anything to avoid.
welcome.required: Please answer the first two questions.
welcome.done: All set. Let Claude analyze your profile next.
identity.title: Basics
identity.name: Name
identity.roleHint: A short line under your name, e.g. “Frontend developer · React”.
identity.photoHint: JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB. A clear portrait works best.
identity.faceHint: Drag on the photo to place your face.
identity.photoType: Use a JPG or PNG image.
identity.photoTooBig: The image is larger than 8 MB.
identity.fontHint: Fonts are bundled locally — rendering works offline.
identity.previewSub: A sample slide with your identity and template.
templates.title: Templates
templates.sub: Same carousel, different look. Your default is used unless you pick another one per carousel.
me.title: Who I am
me.sub: What Claude knows about you. Edit anything — it's used in every carousel.
me.analyzeSub: Claude reads your answers and accounts, then writes your audience, pillars and voice rules.
me.analyzeExtraPh: Paste your bio, your best posts or captions…
me.analyzeExtraHint: The more real examples, the closer the voice.
me.empty.who: Answer the onboarding questions to fill this in.
me.empty.pillars: Run “Analyze” to find your content pillars.
me.empty.voice: Run “Analyze” to write your voice rules.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Your identity, templates, accounts and connection.
accounts.title: Your accounts
accounts.sub: Nothing is fetched automatically. Paste your link and bio so Claude understands your presence.
factorySettings.title: Factory defaults
factorySettings.categoryHint: A small label on the slides, e.g. “Freelancing”.
factorySettings.visualQAHint: Claude looks at the rendered sheet and fixes clipped or crowded slides once. Takes a little longer.
doctor.title: Device checks
doctor.sub: What Sahba needs on this computer.
ideas.title: Idea bank
ideas.sub: Collect ideas, polish them, then send them to the factory.
ideas.quickPh: Write an idea and press Enter…
ideas.dragDisabled: Clear the filters to reorder by dragging.
ideas.col.title: Idea
ideas.emptyBody: Write your first idea above, or let Claude suggest ideas from your profile.
ideas.publishBody: Paste the post link so you can find it later.
ideas.deleteBody: “{title}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
factory.title: Factory
factory.pickSub: Pick an idea to turn into a carousel.
factory.pickEmptyBody: Add an idea in the idea bank first.
factory.draftingElsewhereBody: A run started elsewhere. Refresh in a moment to see the result.
factory.hookHint: The opening line on the cover. “Polish” in the idea bank writes one for you.
factory.hookPh: e.g. 3 mistakes that cost me my first client
factory.outlineHint: One point per line. Claude follows it.
factory.notesPh: e.g. make it more practical, add a code example
factory.remakeBody: Claude will write a new deck. The current one is kept in history.
factory.makeHint: About {n} slides · takes a few minutes
factory.slidesHint: Click a slide to view it large and leave a comment.
factory.noPreviewBody: The deck exists but hasn't been rendered.
factory.commentHint: What should change on this slide? Ctrl+Enter adds it.
factory.commentPh: e.g. shorter title, use a different icon
factory.redoComment: Rewrite this slide with a different angle and visual.
factory.commentsEmpty: Open a slide to leave comments. They're sent together in one request.
factory.noComments: Add at least one comment first.
factory.caption: Caption
factory.historyEmpty: Every change creates a version here.
factory.restoreBody: The deck from {date} will be restored and rendered again.
factory.exportHint: Happy with the slides? Export the final images and caption to a folder.
factory.exportBody: Final images and the caption will be saved to your exports folder. No Claude involved.
factory.exportedBody: Your images and caption are in the folder below. Post them by hand when you're ready.
gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.emptyBody: Make a carousel in the factory and approve it — it shows up here.
log.title: Run log
log.sub: Recent runs — useful when asking for support.
log.emptyBody: Runs appear here after Claude or the renderer does something.
